title: Wavelength and wave speed
hook: Change wavelength and predict wave speed.
misconception: wave speed stays fixed when wavelength doubles.
objective: Apply v = fλ to compare wave speed when wavelength changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With ideal waves in different media whose frequency is held fixed, v = fλ. When wavelength doubles, wave speed becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model v = fλ; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider ideal waves in different media whose frequency is held fixed, with a nonzero initial result. If wavelength triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on wave speed?
recall.why: Apply v = fλ under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
